spec.notes: EXP-B: Cross-model recursive chain. Human→Pythia d1→OLMo finetune on Pythia-d1→GPT-2 XL finetune on OLMo output. Tests whether depth signal persists across model boundaries.

experiment_data.hypothesis: Cross-model recursive chain: Human→Pythia d1→OLMo finetune→GPT-2 XL finetune。验证 depth signal 是否能跨越模型边界累积——即使每一步用不同模型递归，distributional artifacts 仍然可检测。成功标准：chain-d2/d3 的 pairwise AUC > chance, 4-class acc ≥ 50%。
